item.title: U.S. Senator · on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot · 2 candidates
item.description: On the ballot 2026-11-03. 2 candidates listed. Candidates: Don Tracy, Juliana Stratton. Timeline: Primary election Mar 17, 2026 · Voter registration deadline (by mail/online) ~Oct 5, 2026 · Early voting & vote by mail underway ~Oct 19, 2026 · Election Day — general election Nov 3, 2026 · New term begins ~Jan 13, 2027. One of Illinois's two seats in the United States Senate (Class 2). On the Nov 3, 2026 general-election ballot for a six-year term — a partisan race.
